races.name: Qatar Racing British Champions Day Two-Year-Old Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Despite meeting with defeat for the first time, ARAPAHO GOLD arguably enhanced his reputation trying to concede weight all round in the Mill Reef at Newbury and he looks a very solid proposition in this good-quality opening race. Inner City Blues remains a top prospect despite a slightly underwhelming effort in the Middle Park, while Night In Vegas has already had a lucrative season and can make his presence felt again.

  1. ARAPAHO GOLD (IRE)
  2. INNER CITY BLUES (IRE)
  3. NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE)

races.name: Qatar Racing British Champions Long Distance Cup (Group 1)
races.verdict:
Joseph O'Brien's upwardly-mobile stayer HIGHWAYMAN can add to his St Leger triumph and extend his winning sequence to 4 with this first go over 2m bound to suit. Caballo de Mar is a big threat on the back of his game Prix du Cadran success from the absent Scandinavia, although the rejuvenated Gregory is also well in the mix and Ebor 1-3 Daiquiri Bay and Opportunity rate lively outsiders too in this fascinating clash.

  1. HIGHWAYMAN (FR)
  2. CABALLO DE MAR (IRE)
  3. GREGORY

races.name: Qatar Racing British Champions Sprint Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
ALMERAQ is perhaps at his best on a softer surface but his win in the Jubilee at the Royal Meeting here proved he's still a top-class sprinter under quicker conditions and he'll be the one to beat again as he bids for a third top-level success of the campaign. Division wasn't seen to maximum effect in the Bengough but still appeals as one who should prove well suited by this stiff 6f and he can get back on track, with Paborus also likely to make the podium behind Almeraq again.

  1. ALMERAQ
  2. DIVISION
  3. PABORUS

races.name: Qatar Racing British Champions Fillies & Mares Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
Remarkable mare KALPANA has had some tough battles this year but may have enough left in the tank to secure a third successive victory in this race. Minnie Hauk's standout effort this season came when runner-up in the Prince of Wales's Stakes here, and she's feared most if recapturing that sort of form. Sparan Nua was narrowly touched off by Kalpana at York and could be worth another chance to confirm that improvement, while impressive Irish Oaks winner Johanna Walsh isn't taken lightly.

  1. KALPANA
  2. MINNIE HAUK (IRE)
  3. SPARAN NUA (IRE)

races.name: Queen Elizabeth II Stakes (Sponsored By Qatar Racing) (Group 1) (Str)
races.verdict:
This test is likely to bring out the best in MORE THUNDER so he looks the value play in what is a wide-open renewal. Talk of New York is probably the most progressive in the field so is next best ahead of Gstaad, who arguably has the best form having pushed Bow Echo close a couple of times this summer.

  1. MORE THUNDER (IRE)
  2. TALK OF NEW YORK
  3. GSTAAD

races.name: Qatar Racing Champion Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
A much-anticipated renewal, with preference for OMBUDSMAN given the excellent impression he made in the Prince of Wales's Stakes this summer. Having had excuses at York since, he can reverse the placings with Calandagan from last year's race, though the French raider is much respected with his strong course record. Bay City Roller completes the shortlist on the back of his admirable second in the Arc.

  1. OMBUDSMAN (IRE)
  2. CALANDAGAN (IRE)
  3. BAY CITY ROLLER (IRE)

races.name: Balmoral Handicap (Sponsored By Qatar Racing) (Str)
races.verdict:
A switch to hold-up tactics has worked a treat for SCOVILLE and he still looks well treated off 4 lb higher than when winning with a bit to spare at Doncaster last month. The lightly-raced Gavriel was first home on his side in the Cambridgeshire and rates an obvious danger. Irish raider Excellent Believe and the reliable Ebt's Guard also make the shortlist.

  1. SCOVILLE
  2. GAVRIEL
  3. EXCELLENT BELIEVE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF 'National Hunt' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MECENE impressed with his hurdling when getting off the mark at Taunton in the spring and can make a winning return at the chief expense of Trigg who wasn't at his best when an odds-on third at Perth when last seen out but still rates a big threat for the all-conquering Skelton yard. Hurdling debutant Danza Kuduro appeals as the pick of the rest for the minor honours.

  1. MECENE (FR)
  2. TRIGG
  3. DANZA KUDURO (IRE)

races.name: Konsileo Local Award Winning Commercial Insurer Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton's French recruit MISTERDOC created a very good impression when landing a brace of novices last season and looks very much the way to go stepping into handicap company on a handy-looking mark on his reappearance. Mister Ursus was also on the up during the spring and is next on the list ahead of Arbitration, who should find this return to 2m in his favour, and C&D scorer Arctic Voyage.

  1. MISTERDOC (FR)
  2. MISTER URSUS (IRE)
  3. ARBITRATION (IRE)

races.name: Bet With The On Course Bookies Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
PLAYFUL FOX wasn't given a hard time of it when a recent fifth at Uttoxeter on his chasing bow and this dual winning hurdler is fancied to build on it and gain a first win in this sphere. Fencing debutant Annual Invitation brings potential and could emerge as the chief threat, especially if the market vibes are positive. Reteti and Another Folly aren't out of things either.

  1. PLAYFUL FOX (FR)
  2. ANNUAL INVITATION (IRE)
  3. RETETI

races.name: 1st Office Print And IT Solutions Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORMAN FLETCHER is 11 lb below his last winning mark and arrives after bumping into an unexposed one at Uttoxeter last month, so gets the nod. Mount Anglesby held his form well last season and is respected starting out for a new yard, whilst Beorma returned amiss last time but would have a say if back to the sort of prolific form she was showing during the summer.

  1. NORMAN FLETCHER
  2. MOUNT ANGLESBY (IRE)
  3. BEORMA (IRE)

races.name: Dartmoor Magazine Intermediate Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
QUEBECOIS was placed in the Ultima at Cheltenham last season and the smart level of form he showed there should be enough to win this. Recent Uttoxeter winner Country Mile is the main form danger, though he may not be suited by this longer trip, whilst prolific point winner El Capitaine is open to progress under Rules.

  1. QUEBECOIS (FR)
  2. COUNTRY MILE (IRE)
  3. EL CAPITAINE (IRE)

races.name: DGM Robotic Mowers Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
FLASHY BOY is likely still ahead of his mark and can follow up his easy win at Sedgefield if his jumping holds up as well as it did there. Testflight narrowly beat the selection over C&D 4 weeks ago and can pose the biggest threat.

  1. FLASHY BOY (IRE)
  2. TESTFLIGHT
  3. BERTIE WOOSTER (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HAVANOTHERGUINNESS ticks plenty of boxes on paper so he's a straightforward choice to make a winning start. Duhallow Storm failed to live up to market expectations on his debut over C&D back in the spring but could be more of a late developer like his dam, so it's reasonable to believe he should prove capable of better. Sea Glorya finished only fourth on his sole outing in points but has joined a respected yard.

  1. HAVANOTHERGUINNESS
  2. DUHALLOW STORM (IRE)
  3. SEA GLORYA (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
IVOR BEAR failed to win a bumper last season but showed plenty on all 3 outings and there's a strong feeling that jumping could well be the making of him given his physique. He's narrowly preferred to Hold The Throw, who came from a less-than-ideal position to land a steadily-run bumper at Perth in May. Sir Edward Lear showed only a little promise on his hurdling debut at Huntingdon last November but should be capable of better.

  1. IVOR BEAR (IRE)
  2. HOLD THE THROW (IRE)
  3. SIR EDWARD LEAR

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GALWAY REEL was much improved when running out an impressive winner of a 3m handicap chase here on his yard debut 3 weeks ago and is sure to take a bit of stopping if transferring that sort of form back to hurdles from a 4 lb higher mark. Forest Spirit and Daaris head the opposition.

  1. GALWAY REEL (IRE)
  2. FOREST SPIRIT (IRE)
  3. DAARIS (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Jean & Paul Lucas Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FRINGILL DIKE has been in good form over C&D this term and it's possible he could have a fitness edge on some of his reappearing rivals, best of whom may be Neil Mulholland's Scorsese.

  1. FRINGILL DIKE (IRE)
  2. SCORSESE (IRE)
  3. HARDY DU SEUIL (FR)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on the fitness of RIALANNAH, who had a few subsequent winners behind her on the second of her 2 Fakenham victories in the spring and could still be on a favourable mark. The hat-trick seeking The Egyptian Ginge rates an obvious danger. Roaring Home is next on the list.

  1. RIALANNAH (IRE)
  2. THE EGYPTIAN GINGE (IRE)
  3. ROARING HOME

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BALLYGEARY is a quirky type but he gained a second success here over C&D last week, and is weighted to follow up off a 3 lb higher mark. Saint Polo is feared most starting out for Jack Jones with Pergamon also well in the mix in his bid to extend his winning hurdling sequence to five.

  1. BALLYGEARY (IRE)
  2. SAINT POLO (FR)
  3. PERGAMON (FR)

races.name: Pertemps Network Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
HELIOS ALLEN is a long time without a win, but he has started life well for Ben Case and is taken to go one better than when twice runner-up recently and gain a breakthrough success in this sphere. Cap Ricochet rates a big danger on the back of his chasing debut C&D win, while Tom Ellis' new recruit Golly Gosh is also firmly in the picture.

  1. HELIOS ALLEN (FR)
  2. CAP RICOCHET
  3. GOLLY GOSH (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NOSTRAE DE COUGNY makes some appeal on paper for a yard that has sent out a recent bumper winner and, with the booking of Sean Bowen signalling intent, he earns the vote. Last of My Kind and Miss Ocean are a couple of others to note.

  1. NOSTRAE DE COUGNY (FR)
  2. LAST OF MY KIND
  3. MISS OCEAN

races.name: EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
From the inside stall and with the drop to 7f no issue, QUEENS BANDIT will take some stopping in what is an ordinary maiden. Lion's Den should make natural progression with his debut behind him and is feared most, ahead of Lord Percy, who finished behind the selection latest.

  1. QUEENS BANDIT
  2. LION'S DEN (IRE)
  3. LORD PERCY (IRE)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Unlike her chief form rivals, INKBERROW retains the scope to rate higher and following a smooth success at Wolverhampton she can successfully concede weight all round. Black Orchid may well extend her sequence of runner-up efforts to 6, with Poor Relation likely to be sticking to her task.

  1. INKBERROW (IRE)
  2. BLACK ORCHID
  3. POOR RELATION (FR)

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
There's an air of unfinished business around TEMPLE in handicaps and with James Owen likely to bring out the best in him, he looks a very appealing candidate in first-time headgear. This is a pretty deep contest, though, with Be Patient and Parisian Scholar likely to be bang there.

  1. TEMPLE
  2. BE PATIENT
  3. PARISIAN SCHOLAR

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Veterans' Handicap
races.verdict:
Having dropped to a very handy mark, BALDOMERO came up agonisingly short at York last week and that performance strongly suggests that he's ready to cash in. Rosenpur has a handy draw to exploit and that makes him dangerous, with Tyger Bay and Woodstock also of interest.

  1. BALDOMERO (IRE)
  2. ROSENPUR (GER)
  3. TYGER BAY

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BRIGHTON BOY turned in his best effort of the season when winning at Pontefract earlier in the month and he is taken to follow up back in class 4 company. Von Trotter is 2 from 3 since upped to this trip and is feared most, while Quest For Fun helps to give Tim Easterby a strong hand in the race.

  1. BRIGHTON BOY (IRE)
  2. VON TROTTER
  3. QUEST FOR FUN

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Successful at Beverley in July, IT JUST TAKES TIME drops back into class 4 company for the first time since and is worth a chance to bounce back with a visor applied. Classy Clarets is much respected, though, as he arrives in top form, with Vince le Prince also in the mix.

  1. IT JUST TAKES TIME (IRE)
  2. CLASSY CLARETS (IRE)
  3. VINCE LE PRINCE

races.name: William Hill Catterick Dash Handicap
races.verdict:
LEXINGTON BLITZ is likely in much better heart than recent form figures might suggest and he's taken to follow up his success in this corresponding event 12 months ago. Baker Blue looks interesting back in a handicap from a handy draw and could be the main threat. Spartan Arrow also appeals off a much-reduced mark, in what looks a wide-open renewal.

  1. LEXINGTON BLITZ (IRE)
  2. BAKER BLUE
  3. SPARTAN ARROW (IRE)

races.name: Go Racing In Yorkshire Future Stars Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
GENTLE WARRIOR has been running in much better company of late and while not the most straightforward, he could be worth a chance dropped into this sort of grade. There are no such attitude concerns for Captain Cairney, who has solid claims to add to his tally, with Wasthatok still on a potentially handy mark for his Flat return.

  1. GENTLE WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY
  3. WASTHATOK

races.name: Keogh & Hows Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Useful bumper winner ONE KNIGHT is the one to beat if back on song. Katarcice and Tao Enki both look credible dangers.

  1. ONE KNIGHT (IRE)
  2. KATARCICE (FR)
  3. TAO ENKI (FR)

races.name: Bet With On Course Bookmakers Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KILWORTH appeals as one who could do well over fences this season and receives the vote. Senator is another interesting chase newcomer and may provide a bigger threat than Depalma, who endured a hard race when beaten at short odds at Newton Abbot on his most recent outing.

  1. KILWORTH (IRE)
  2. SENATOR (FR)
  3. DEPALMA (IRE)

races.name: Tracey- Ann Hen Day To Remember Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A tightly-knit handicap that could go the way of LIKEWHATYOUSEE, who was set to show improved form when falling in a more-competitive event on handicap bow at Worcester last time. She's narrowly preferred to the returning Watamu, who looks a serious danger on the strength of her novice form. Course-specialist Roarin' Success completes the shortlist.

  1. LIKEWHATYOUSEE (USA)
  2. WATAMU
  3. ROARIN' SUCCESS

races.name: Roy G. T. Clark 100th Birthday Memorial Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GONE IN SIXTY failed to fire at Southwell a couple of weeks ago but is taken to bounce straight back at the scene of last month's win. Mersey Street rates an obvious threat, while Kit's Coty returned from a break to win off 5 lb higher at a similar time last season.

  1. GONE IN SIXTY
  2. MERSEY STREET (IRE)
  3. KIT'S COTY (IRE)

races.name: Value With Oncourse Bookmakers Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LADY DAPPLE ROSE was all set to collect when unseating at Hereford on Tuesday. She gets the vote off an unchanged mark, though this is no penalty kick with interesting stable-switcher Teorie in opposition.

  1. LADY DAPPLE ROSE (IRE)
  2. TEORIE (IRE)
  3. SERAPHIC (IRE)

races.name: Invades Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
If ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY is over Monday's exertions at Worcester he should prove hard to beat in a contest where the opposition doesn't look strong. Applejack Poet was third when the selection won at Worcester last month and might be the one to follow him home.

  1. ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE)
  2. APPLEJACK POET (IRE)
  3. BLACKIJO DAGROSTIS (FR)

races.name: Annual Membership For Christmas Female Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ASHDOWN FOREST's latest form has been well advertised and a return to 2m may see him double his tally for the Skeltons. Mayday Games and Mojo Ego head the dangers in a tricky finale.

  1. ASHDOWN FOREST (IRE)
  2. MAYDAY GAMES (IRE)
  3. MOJO EGO (IRE)

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap
races.verdict:
AVATAR JET is well handicapped if first-time headgear sparks a return to form so he could be worth chancing. Last-time-out winners Adelaide Bay, Portman Blue and El Fox all look lively dangers.

  1. AVATAR JET (IRE)
  2. ADELAIDE BAY
  3. PORTMAN BLUE

races.name: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
THE THIRD STAR took her form to another level when forging clear over C&D 6 weeks ago and she looks capable of making it 3 from 3 here. Wid is a clear next best with her form from last time working out well.

  1. THE THIRD STAR
  2. WID (IRE)
  3. ALWAYS HAPPY (IRE)

races.name: Saturday 24th October Gents Night Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
KODY B was well positioned when scoring at Newcastle but is given the benefit of the doubt as it was his first run on all-weather. Split Elevens is a solid alternative.

  1. KODY B (IRE)
  2. SPLIT ELEVENS
  3. ROYAL JET

races.name: Saturday 24th October Gents Night Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
SHAW PARK has responded well to headgear of late and the return to his ideal distance should see him to best effect. The well bred and unexposed Encore looks the obvious threat on handicap bow, while this shorter trip could suit Always Blue given how she shaped last time.

  1. SHAW PARK (IRE)
  2. ENCORE (FR)
  3. ALWAYS BLUE

races.name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FULLY STOCKED bumped into a progressive one last time and sets a clear standard on that effort. Palms Oasis and Ardad Apollo both appeal as likely to build on their promising debut efforts and can complete the placings.

  1. FULLY STOCKED (IRE)
  2. PALMS OASIS
  3. ARDAD APOLLO

races.name: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Handicap
races.verdict:
BLACK MISSILE is now on a workable mark and should find the return to 6f in his favour so he gets the verdict over King Cherry, who'll benefit from this return to all-weather, and the consistent Beach Partee.

  1. BLACK MISSILE (IRE)
  2. KING CHERRY (IRE)
  3. BEACH PARTEE

races.name: Southwell Racecourse Conference And Events EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
INGLEWOOD was beaten only by a newcomer last time and she is narrowly given the verdict over Oxbridge, who failed to justify short odds on his Wolverhampton debut. Silent Sadhu might be best of the rest.

  1. INGLEWOOD
  2. OXBRIDGE (IRE)
  3. SILENT SADHU

races.name: Andrew And Tony Roy Memorial Race Handicap
races.verdict:
This is a thin race and SATYRESS can extend her winning run to 6. Better can be expected from bumper winner Crystal Jet now handicapping over a longer trip, with Belle Amie taken to complete the 1-2-3.

  1. SATYRESS
  2. CRYSTAL JET (FR)
  3. BELLE AMIE (SWE)

races.name: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap
races.verdict:
EMMA'S LETTER still looked in good form having met significant trouble in running over C&D last month and she gets the nod. Thankfully shaped well on her first try over this far at Ayr last month and is also considered, whilst Captain Fox has slipped to what looks a competitive mark.

  1. EMMA'S LETTER
  2. THANKFULLY (IRE)
  3. CAPTAIN FOX (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MARCO DU SEUIL, a Grade 3 winner on his sole outing in bumpers, shaped encouragingly sent hurdling when runner-up in a 2m maiden at Ballinrobe in May and is taken to go one better with improvement on the cards. Mailloche found only one too good in a juvenile hurdle at Auteuil a year ago and surely has more improvement in him having joined Willie Mullins. Bunker Buster was sent off a well-backed favourite when unseating at the first on his recent Gowran hurdling debut and he retains potential.

  1. MARCO DU SEUIL (FR)
  2. MAILLOCHE (FR)
  3. BUNKER BUSTER (IRE)

races.name: Thisisracing Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and this could go the way of points scorer JENNYFROMTHEBLOCK who should strip sharper for her Listowel fifth after an absence and is likely to prove suited by this longer distance. Mia In Milan wasn't seen to ideal effect when sixth in a Clonmel handicap last time and could emerge as the main danger, although Poet's Duke has the form to play a big part if back to his best. Akako is likely to build on a recent Clonmel sixth and another to consider.

  1. JENNYFROMTHEBLOCK (IRE)
  2. MIA IN MILAN (IRE)
  3. POET'S DUKE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cailin Alainn Mares Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
CARRIED WITH LOVE impressed when making a winning start over fences on stable debut last month and she's fancied to double up over hurdles. World Of Fortunes chased home Millstream Lady in this corresponding event 12 months ago and may turn the tables to secure silver for the second successive year.

  1. CARRIED WITH LOVE (IRE)
  2. WORLD OF FORTUNES (IRE)
  3. MILLSTREAM LADY (IRE)

races.name: Master Chefs Novice Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
There's surely better to come from very useful Flat stayer DALLAS STAR, especially over this longer trip, and he may well follow up his strong-looking hurdling debut success. Emerald Enigma and Luck Between Us stand out as the dangers, with Tinto De Verano preferred of the rest.

  1. DALLAS STAR (FR)
  2. EMERALD ENIGMA (IRE)
  3. LUCK BETWEEN US (IRE)

races.name: Master Chefs Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GLIN ROAD BOY was well backed when landing a competitive Listowel handicap in September and, with that form working out well, he is taken to defy a 13 lb rise, while Build A Bridge rates the main danger if reproducing his Punchestown gamble win and lightly-raced Zuzukel is respected from an in-form yard.

  1. GLIN ROAD BOY (IRE)
  2. BUILD A BRIDGE (IRE)
  3. ZUZUKEL (FR)

races.name: Greenpark Limerick Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
AT THE WINGS has been thriving of late and is fancied to defy another rise in the weights and complete his hat-trick, with the longer trip expected to suit. Dalmatic won over C&D last December and, with a recent run now under his belt, he can prove the main danger, with Western Opera and Friar Hogan also respected.

  1. AT THE WINGS (IRE)
  2. DALMATIC (IRE)
  3. WESTERN OPERA (IRE)

races.name: Greenpark Limerick Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
BLACKWATER SOLDIER has quickly set about making up for lost time since returning from a lengthy absence and is fancied to go one better than last time. Tantrum Boy looks the main danger if building on his Wexford run while Calzaghi, who should appreciate the drop in trip, is also capable of playing a part along with Run For The Border.

  1. BLACKWATER SOLDIER (IRE)
  2. TANTRUM BOY (IRE)
  3. CALZAGHI (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
THE OCEAN QUEEN shaped a bit better than the distance beaten suggests on her recent Rules debut at Listowel and looks sure to build on that run, so she's an appealing candidate. Dinner Dance left the impression she would have gone close with a smoother run in a Downpatrick bumper in May and is open to improvement, while All Noise is one to note in the betting having been purchased for a handsome sum after winning her sole outing in points.

  1. THE OCEAN QUEEN (IRE)
  2. DINNER DANCE (IRE)
  3. ALL NOISE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
The return to left-handed Leopardstown may help ZENITH BLAZE who is selected to improve past the more established Speckles. Duchessofaquitaine and Captivating are just 2 of a few interesting newcomers.

  1. ZENITH BLAZE
  2. SPECKLES (IRE)
  3. DUCHESSOFAQUITAINE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
MOUNT MERU shaped well amidst greenness when runner-up on his Gowran debut and is taken to go one better now, perhaps at the main expense of the Aidan O'Brien pair Kingdom of Camelot and Aladdin's Cave. Louis de Foix and the other Aidan O'Brien runner, Pirate of Penzance, are newcomers to monitor closely in the betting.

  1. MOUNT MERU
  2. KINGDOM OF CAMELOT (FR)
  3. ALADDIN'S CAVE (IRE)

races.name: Mongey Communications Eyrefield Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
WALL STREET created a good impression on his course debut and can make it 2-2 at the expense of stablemate Albany County. Leadlight may prove best of the remainder.

  1. WALL STREET
  2. ALBANY COUNTY (IRE)
  3. LEADLIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Laidlaw Cup Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SNOWING showed much improved form when third in a listed race here last month and, having faced a tough ask in a Newmarket Group 1 since, she looks to hold leading claims back in maiden company. Sensational Filly shaped promisingly on debut and is next on the list, while Taranga makes plenty of appeal on paper.

  1. SNOWING (IRE)
  2. SENSATIONAL FILLY (FR)
  3. TARANGA (FR)

races.name: Mongey Communications Killavullan Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
CAPABILITY BROWN has been improving in leaps and bounds, looking a smart prospect when winning a Curragh maiden at the end of last month, and he can take this step up in grade in his stride. Stablemate Bengal Tiger also arrives on the back of a clear-cut maiden success and could be the main danger, ahead of Trean.

  1. CAPABILITY BROWN (IRE)
  2. BENGAL TIGER (IRE)
  3. TREAN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
The market should reveal plenty in this fascinating maiden but the vote goes to Paddy Twomey's unraced Justify colt DRIVE ON THERE who appeals on pedigree and holds an entry in next spring's Irish 2000 Guineas. Aidan O'Brien saddles three and his Wootton Bassett debutant Accumulation also commands plenty of respect. Critical Reason shaped well on his recent Curragh debut and could emerge as the pick of those with experience ahead of Naas debut third First Watch.

  1. DRIVE ON THERE (USA)
  2. ACCUMULATION (IRE)
  3. CRITICAL REASON (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
ADMIRED BEAUTY resumed her progress when gaining a breakthrough success at Naas recently and with Billy Lee an eye-catching booking for the yard she is fancied to make a winning start to life in nurseries here. Snapequus also looks to have better days ahead of him, though, and rates a major threat, while City of Gold and Banks of The Boyne can have a say too in this intriguing nursery.

  1. ADMIRED BEAUTY (IRE)
  2. SNAPEQUUS (IRE)
  3. CITY OF GOLD
